observations.content: Repository is on detached HEAD with branch map/AGNT-0032 available; commit 45821295f is titled "Implement AGNT-0032 row-parallel frontier" and changes 21 skill-eval files with 1,356 insertions and 800 deletions.

Frontier spending is tracked in spent_millionths_of_dollar across model/state/report/store/service code; scheduler reserves an entire wave using maximum_trial_cost_millionths_of_dollar and pauses when projected spend exceeds spending_limit_millionths_of_dollar, with overflow checks.

Frontier scheduler tests confirm a whole wave may exactly reach a limit of 100, while spent 61 pauses with PoolPauseReason::SpendingLimit; reservation and projected-spend overflow return InvalidConfiguration errors, and persisted paused or terminal states do not dispatch.

Frontier lifecycle tests confirm a full fake run executes 30 trials with no candidate timeout, uses the exact unbounded candidate route at T5, persists 30 trials, and ends AwaitingDecision with spend 60; each durable trial is saved before parent state save.

Frontier lifecycle tests confirm quota pauses after 29 trials and resume executes only the missing trial, including after a quota discovery snapshot ages out; infrastructure failures persist bounded retry events across resume and a subsequent resume makes no extra call once exhausted.

Frontier lifecycle tests confirm recovered trials exceeding the frozen reservation are rejected before append, and a parent save failure can recover a durable trial on resume without duplicating the model call.

Frontier resume validates harness identity and persisted model progress before model calls: harness drift, tampered selected routes/next tier/next thinking index/exhaustion, corrupt durable trials, terminal resume, and plan drift all fail without another model call.

Frontier wave execution validates each recovered or produced trial against the frozen reservation, rejects zero/invalid/mismatched reservations or projected over-limit spend, sorts outcomes deterministically, and commits scheduled outcomes after recovery or parallel execution.

Frontier state validation enforces frozen evidence versions, nonempty unique entrant/model identities, model-progress alignment, valid unique cells and terminal-cell evidence, and spending not exceeding the frozen limit.

Frontier transition validation preserves frozen configuration, permits only defined lifecycle status transitions, requires an acceptance ledger for Accepted status, prevents model progress/cell evidence/infrastructure events/spending regression, and prevents changes to terminal cells or prior decisions.

T1 screening campaign reports compute remaining judge budget as approved total minus aggregate run spend with checked subtraction; campaign store validates aggregate spend equals the exact run sum, is monotonic, and never exceeds the approved total.
